name: CENNETIC FA200-5 Compact 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The FA200-5 is a compact 5-axis machining center for high-precision 5-sided and simultaneous 5-axis work on small components.
body:
The FA200-5 is a compact 5-axis machining center for high-precision 5-sided and simultaneous 5-axis work on small components.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
